discovery_map_listing.name: Discovery map listing
discovery_map_listing.detail: Your truck appears on the public HatchGrab map so nearby customers can find you.

web_dashboard.name: Universal web dashboard
web_dashboard.detail: Run your service from any phone, tablet or laptop browser.

qr_code.name: QR code
qr_code.detail: A printable QR code that opens your menu and ordering page.

schedule_import.name: Automatic schedule import
schedule_import.detail: We fill your schedule automatically — from your website, or a photo you already post to Facebook. You just review and confirm.

meal_deals_upsells.name: Meal deals & upsells
meal_deals_upsells.detail: Bundle items into deals and offer add-ons at checkout to lift the average order.

walkup_orders.name: Walk-up order processing
walkup_orders.detail: Take and manage orders at the hatch, paid on your own card terminal.

sold_out_toggle.name: Instant sold-out toggle
sold_out_toggle.detail: Mark any item sold out in one tap — it greys out for customers straight away.

online_ordering_pay_at_hatch.name: Online ordering — Pay at Hatch
online_ordering_pay_at_hatch.detail: Customers order ahead online and pay in person when they collect.

kitchen_app.name: iPhone, iPad and Android kitchen app
kitchen_app.detail: The fullest way to run HatchGrab: a live kitchen screen, plus the only way to keep taking orders when you lose signal.

offline_protection.name: Offline order protection
offline_protection.detail: If your internet drops mid-service, orders are held safely and sync when you’re back — you never lose one.

online_payments.name: Online payments
online_payments.detail: Take card payment upfront when customers order online, via Stripe.

advance_preordering.name: Advance pre-ordering
advance_preordering.detail: Let customers order for a future date or time before the event.

preorder_deadline.name: Pre-order deadline
preorder_deadline.detail: Set a cut-off time for items that need notice.

time_slot_selection.name: Customer time slot selection
time_slot_selection.detail: Customers pick a collection time slot, spreading demand across your service.

kitchen_capacity.name: Kitchen capacity management
kitchen_capacity.detail: Set how much your kitchen can cook at a time and how long it takes. Once a slot is full, customers can’t pick it.

stock_countdown.name: Automated stock countdown
stock_countdown.detail: Set a stock count and it counts down as orders come in, then sells out automatically.

auto_accept.name: Auto-accept online orders
auto_accept.detail: Online orders are accepted automatically — no need to confirm each one.

branded_qr_code.name: Branded QR code
branded_qr_code.detail: Add your logo to your QR code.

private_events.name: Private events
private_events.detail: Add private events that don’t show on the map, with their own private ordering link and QR code.

social_media_posts.name: Social media posts
social_media_posts.detail: Upload your designs — we add your dates, places and times for each week and event automatically.

whatsapp_auto_replies.name: WhatsApp auto-replies
whatsapp_auto_replies.detail: Auto-reply to WhatsApp enquiries about your menu and schedule.

messenger_instagram_replies.name: Messenger & Instagram auto-replies
messenger_instagram_replies.detail: Same as WhatsApp auto-replies, for Messenger and Instagram enquiries.

tap_to_pay.name: Take payment on your phone
tap_to_pay.detail: Take card payments on a supported phone, so you don’t need a separate card machine.

advanced_reporting.name: Advanced reporting
advanced_reporting.detail: Break sales down by date range, item and event to see what’s really selling.

sms_order_alerts.name: SMS order alerts
sms_order_alerts.detail: Text customers automatically when their order’s ready. Will carry an additional charge (price to be confirmed).

multi_device_kitchen.name: Multi-device kitchen sync
multi_device_kitchen.detail: Run several screens — front counter and kitchen — all showing the same live orders.

multi_user_access.name: Multi-user access
multi_user_access.detail: Give staff their own logins with the right level of access.

embed_schedule.name: Schedule page on your own website
embed_schedule.detail: Show your upcoming dates on your own website. Each one links straight through to its order page.

event_types.name: Custom event types & pricing
event_types.detail: Create your own event types, with custom prices and settings for events and festivals.

buzzer_tracking.name: Buzzer tracking
buzzer_tracking.detail: Give an order a buzzer number when you hand one out, so you know which buzzer belongs to which order.

ticket_printing.name: Kitchen ticket printing
ticket_printing.detail: Print order tickets to a Bluetooth or wired printer in the kitchen.

customer_display.name: Customer-facing display
customer_display.detail: A screen customers can see showing order numbers and when they’re ready.

loyalty_stamp_cards.name: Digital loyalty stamp cards
loyalty_stamp_cards.detail: Reward repeat customers with digital stamp cards — collected and redeemed automatically.

landing.offlineProtectionDetail: If you lose signal, online ordering pauses so customers can’t place orders you won’t see. The iPhone, iPad and Android app keeps you taking orders offline; the web dashboard needs a connection.
landing.mergedAutoRepliesDetail: Auto-reply to enquiries about your menu and schedule on WhatsApp, Messenger and Instagram.
